reason: The current MaskedSASRec achieves macro validation HR@10 of 0.565 versus the baseline's 0.505, supporting a focused architectural experiment that preserves its training setup. Absolute positions require attention to infer relative distances; explicit distance biases may help, although Electronics' 0.45 HR@10 does not establish this as its limitation. The failed historical causal relative-bias experiment argues for caution and an isolated test of the proposed signed distances in the current bidirectional model, while historical sampled-softmax successes support retaining the objective. Select model_design for attention changes and training_evaluation for checkpoint reconstruction, predictor parity, and targeted verification.

plan.model_design: Add an independently parameterized, jointly trained relative-position bias table of shape [127, num_heads] to every MaskedSASRec encoder layer, using index = clamp(query_position - key_position, -63, 63) + 63 and initializing every entry to zero without consuming additional initialization RNG. Gather biases as [num_heads, length, length], broadcast across the batch, combine with the existing padding-key exclusion as an additive attention mask in the attention computation dtype, and add before softmax while retaining bidirectional attention, absolute positional embeddings, and the final query-mask token. Implement explicit encoder-layer attention execution so both training and evaluation use these biases and no TransformerEncoder fused path silently bypasses them; retain the current pre-normalization, attention projections, residuals, feedforward layers, dropout, and output transformation. Unlike the failed historical causal logarithmic-bucket experiment, retain exact signed distances through 63 and introduce no causal mask, pooling path, capacity change, or loss modification, thereby isolating the initial hypothesis. Preserve MaskedSASRec.__init__, forward(self, sequence), predict(self, sequence, candidates), existing variable names and compatible parameter names, tied item embeddings, jointly learned item_bias, and every existing training hyperparameter.
plan.training_evaluation: Update write_predict_script and checkpoint reconstruction so working/predict.py imports the extended MaskedSASRec, strictly loads every layer's relative-bias parameters, and preserves predict(user_id, history, candidates, *, dataset_name=None), prediction_sequence, all four dataset routes, and exactly one newly trained selected checkpoint per category. Add small RNG-preserving checks for signed-distance orientation and clipping, zero-bias equivalence against the unchanged architecture with identical common weights, finite empty and left-padded history scores, padding-key exclusion, nonzero bias gradients, bidirectional attention, and score agreement after strict checkpoint reload. Keep preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42 and worker seeding, supplied splits, masking and prefix sampling, 1,024-negative sampled-softmax objective and weighting, AdamW settings, learning rate, batch size, dropout, hidden dimension, blocks, heads, maximum length, clipping, PATIENCE=25, CATEGORY_SECONDS=2400, and SASREC_EPOCHS with default 200 unchanged. Preserve make_validation's isolated seed-42 RNG, 200 users per category, 99 unique negatives, every-epoch validation, existing HR@10/NDCG lexicographic checkpoint selection, and identical validation/prediction preprocessing; assess the hypothesis against the observed 0.565 macro HR@10 using authoritative host validation without treating the proposed improvement range as an observed result. Retain DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], trial-local checkpoints, metadata and predictor artifacts, single-GPU execution within the shared budget, and all four categories, with no hidden-test access, external data, other-trial access, ensembles, checkpoint averaging, or separately fitted scoring components.
